children: Atara Development, a UAE-based boutique developer, has announced the launch of Velora Residence, a boutique collection of 58 fully furnished homes on Dubai Islands.

Positioned between the waterfront and the boulevard, the development brings together the energy of the city and its island setting through clean architectural lines, light-filled interiors and natural materials, said a statement from the developer.

Located on Island A, Dubai Islands, Velora Residence brings together a waterfront setting and boulevard connectivity. Its one- and two-bedroom residences, ranging from 857-1,857 sq ft, offers a considered mix of layouts designed for both individual and family living.

Clean architectural lines, light-filled interiors and natural materials define the residences with the relationship between indoor and outdoor spaces forming an integral part of the design narrative, stated the developer.
The development embodies Atara’s site-first philosophy, with each residence shaped by the distinctive character of its surroundings.

Water, air, light and wood apprise its design approach, creating a connection between the built environment and nature while balancing personal wellbeing with the shared experiences of family life, it added.

Unveiling the project, Atara said the Velora Residence brings a design-led perspective to waterfront living, with an emphasis on the relationship between architecture, the natural environment and the experience of home.

At the heart of the development is “The Curated Pause”, a design concept built on four elements: water, air, light and wood. Architecture and the natural setting are treated as part of the everyday living experience rather than as a backdrop. Rather than treating wellbeing as an additional feature, the philosophy places it within the fabric of everyday living.

The intention is to create a residential experience that accommodates the changing rhythms of a household from moments of solitude and reflection to the routines, conversations and shared experiences that bring families together.
At its core, Velora Residence explores a more nuanced expression of waterfront living, where the value of a home lies as much in how it feels to inhabit as in where it stands.

"We believe the next chapter of residential development will be defined not only by where people choose to live, but by how thoughtfully a home responds to the way they want to live," remarked its COO Umid Bazarov.

"With Velora Residence, we chose a boutique scale deliberately. It allows for closer attention to detail, a stronger connection to the surrounding environment and a more personal residential experience," noted Bazarov.

"The design draws on water, air, light and wood, reflecting our view that a home should support both individual wellbeing and family life. Through ‘The Curated Pause’, we want to offer residents a balance between the pace of the city and everyday living, in a home that feels connected to Dubai while giving them space to enjoy it on their own terms," he added.

title: ZAWYA: Atara unveils boutique waterfront project on Dubai Islands
